اعتزلتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَلَتَا (iʕtazalatā) /iʕ.ta.za.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اُعْتُزِلَتَا (uʕtuzilatā) /uʕ.tu.zi.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
